newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: ICRC to try to visit captured opposition general.
newsitem.headline: ICRC to try to visit captured opposition general.

text.p: A representative of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is to try to visit Ismael Khan, an opposition general captured on Monday by the purist Islamic Taleban, according to a spokesman in Kabul.
A report on Taleban-controlled Radio Shariat said that Khan was being held in the Taleban stronghold of Kandahar in southern Afghanistan.

"The Red Cross were informed through Radio Shariat that Ismael Khan was being detained in Kandahar. The delegates there will try to meet the proper authorities to try and get access to Ismael Khan," ICRC spokesman Jean-Luc Paladini told reporters in Kabul on Saturday.

Khan, a former governor of the western Afghan city of Herat until it fell to the Taleban in September 1995, was fighting for the opposition on their western front line close to the border with Faryab province.
